f04.fig_alternatives.callout: The model's own features predict whether an applicant is 50 or over with an AUROC of 0.782. Removing the strongest carriers of age one at a time moves the base variant's predictive equality from 0.46 to 0.57 and its recall from 49.0% to 44.2%. The model is kept and bounded to asking for documents, never to declining.

provenance.population: Bank account applications in the BAF suite, base and variant II, 300,000 each

f04.fig_alternatives.title: What parity costs: the search for a less discriminatory alternative

f04.fig_baf.callout: At a 5% false positive rate the model finds 49.0% of fraudulent applications in the base variant and 49.3% in variant II. Genuine applicants aged 50 and over are flagged at 9.19% against 4.19% for the rest, a predictive equality of 0.46 (0.44 in variant II), though the model never sees age.

provenance.population: Bank account applications in the BAF suite, base and variant II, 300,000 each

f04.fig_baf.title: Application fraud under the BAF suite's fairness protocol

f04.fig_card_fairness.callout: At the operating point, genuine transactions of cardholders 60 and over are declined at 0.34% and those of cardholders under 25 at 0.20%, a ratio of 0.60. Sparkov generates age and gender, so they can be measured here; the model never sees either.

provenance.population: Sparkov card transactions, June to August 2026

f04.fig_card_fairness.title: Who the card model declines wrongly, by age band and gender

f04.fig_cost.callout: False declines cost $12.00 each and missed fraud costs its amount plus $35.00. The threshold that minimised the sum on the validation months, 0.0503, costs $24,927 on the test months against $1,573,327 for approving everything. Accuracy would have chosen 0.6376 and cost $89,153.

provenance.population: Sparkov card transactions, June to August 2026

f04.fig_cost.title: Expected cost of fraud by decline threshold, test months

f04.fig_lag.callout: On 2026-08-31, 200,569 of 472,370 scored decisions were still inside the 60 day chargeback window. Precision over the labelled ones was 73.4%. A figure that treated the unlabelled declines as mistakes would read 27.0%.

provenance.population: Sparkov card transactions, June to August 2026

f04.fig_lag.title: What the desk could know, day by day

f04.fig_pr.callout: At the operating point the desk declines with precision 74.8% and recall 97.6%; the queue point narrows to precision 89.7% for the analyst queue.

provenance.population: Sparkov card transactions, June to August 2026

f04.fig_pr.title: Precision and recall across thresholds, test months
